method: per-stream refusal directions: per layer and hc stream, mean(harmful) - mean(harmless) at the last prompt token, the harmless-mean span projected out, two groups over four framings (N,NA|H,HA) orthonormalised within a stream, unit per stream
groups: N,NA | H,HA (thinking off/on, with and without a coding-agent system prompt)
prompts: alesha-pro/Hy4-flash-Uncensored-GGUF collection prompts (AdvBench train / Alpaca train)
base_model: tencent-hy Hy4-flash, iqr v4 u3 4-bit -- the quant this host serves
derivation: the published recipe, run here on this quant's taps rather than on their FP8 weights

measured.note: held-out sets are the publisher's advbench-val (64) + jailbreakbench (82), greedy, 448 tokens

note: projection h -= (h . v) v, once per group per layer, each stream against its own row. Loaded only when the deployment asks (--control-vector); the request default is off, because what it removes is a safety behaviour.
